property_summary: The deployer-admin retains the right to set owner for every owner value: after admin sets owner to an arbitrary fuzzed address x, a subsequent setOwner by admin must still succeed and take effect — but in the mutant the access check compares against owner, so once owner != admin the admin permanently loses access and the second setOwner reverts.
change_summary: Change the access check from msg.sender == admin to msg.sender == owner, so a different address can call setOwner and set owner.
